integration_findings.title: Inventory Rule and Inquiry AI Runtime have different responsibilities
integration_findings.resolution: Offline-sale inventory remains deterministic Rule/SQL. MockAIRuntime is used only for inquiry-classification integration.

integration_findings.title: AI Response and Frontend InsightSummary are different contracts
integration_findings.resolution: Do not insert raw ai-response.v0.1 objects directly into /api/v1/insights. A Backend projection boundary is required.

integration_findings.title: model_run_id null cannot distinguish Rule from AI Mock
integration_findings.resolution: Frontend provenance must not rely only on model_run_id. Additive source/provenance contract should be agreed in a later integration task.

integration_findings.title: Duplicate inquiry replay invoked the AI consumer more than once
integration_findings.resolution: The mock_ai_inquiry consumer now checks and records its own business-effect identity after a validated response, so accepted/replayed inbox counts remain separate from one AI effect.

integration_findings.title: Pipeline mutation made a validated AI response fail its schema
integration_findings.resolution: Validated ai-response.v0.1 objects are stored unchanged. correlation_id remains in the pipeline structured-log context rather than being added to the closed AI response schema.
